{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the sentinel value in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check revenue format
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]}")

# Check channel distribution
print(f"Channel distribution:\n{df['channel'].value_counts()}")

# Check customer_segment distribution
print(f"Customer segment distribution:\n{df['customer_segment'].value_counts()}")

# Check if channel and customer_segment are confounded
print(f"Channel vs customer_segment cross-tab:\n{pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])}")

# Verify that revenue is indeed strings with commas
print(f"Unique revenue values with commas: {df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum()}")"}
